document_types.aadhaar_card: Aadhaar card or e-Aadhaar letter, masked (KYC)
document_types.salary_slip: Monthly salary slip or pay advice (income)
document_types.form_16: Form 16 TDS certificate from the employer (income)
document_types.itr: Income tax return, ITR-V acknowledgement or computation of income (income)
document_types.bank_statement: Bank statement or passbook (income and banking)
document_types.gst_certificate: GST registration certificate or GSTIN details (self-employed)
document_types.sale_deed: Sale deed or conveyance deed (property title)
document_types.allotment_letter: Allotment letter from a builder or development authority (property)
document_types.utility_bill: Electricity, gas, water or phone bill (address proof)
document_types.other: Anything else: rent agreement, credit card statement, offer letter, invoice, policy
